messages:
maria gonzalez: Just got a 48-page questionnaire from CareSync (signed PO imminent). It's HIPAA + GDPR, heavy on audit logs and retention. Sales asked if we can commit to 7 years for audit logs. Uploading PDF to the thread.

jon li: link pls

maria gonzalez: https://drive.redwood/caresync/CSQ-2026-03.pdf :paperclip: key asks: longer audit log retention, per-tenant export, and proof of access controls (KMS/HSM).

sanjay rao: 7 years is long. Our current plan for Hosted defaults to 2 years, Dedicated can be configured up to 5 if requested. Private can do anything. Product decision needed: do we accept 7y as product ask or advise customer to use Private/Dedicated?

emily park: For prioritization we need launch criteria: security signoff + infra cost estimate + SLA adjustments. Also need exact list of additional fields they want in audit logs.

maria gonzalez: Sales says they can accept price delta but need answer by EOW. They're also asking for per-tenant retention config at route level.

sanjay rao: From runtime POV adding per-tenant retention metadata and export endpoints is medium effort: ~3 sprints plus infra for cold storage. Alternative: offer an 'export-on-demand' and manual long-term archiving via S3 integration.

emily park: Can we capture minimal acceptance criteria now? Proposal: (1) Product doc with scope, (2) Security review complete, (3) PO signed with retention add-on, (4) Implementation plan and cost estimate. If all met, push to Dedicated roadmap as a scoped initiative.

jon li: +1. Also flag for privacy/legal: need DPA update for retention > 2y. @compliance-bot can you start the intake?

compliance-bot: New intake created: CARESYNC-2026. Required documents: questionnaire PDF, requested retention windows, KMS requirements. Assigned to legal@redwood and sec-eng. Intake link: https://redwood.ops/intake/CARESYNC-2026

maria gonzalez: I'll attach a short extract of the retention asks:
```
- audit_logs.retention_days: 2555  # 7 years
- per_tenant.export: true
- export_formats: csv,json,parquet
```
Can we get an estimated T-shirt size for product/dev?

sanjay rao: T-shirt: L. Break into: (A) per-tenant retention config (M), (B) export endpoints (S), (C) long-term cold storage lifecycle (M-L).

emily park: Decision: move to 'needs scoping' in product backlog, assign owner, ask sales to negotiate 5y or Private. If customer insists on 7y, escalate to GM for special contract.

maria gonzalez: noted. I'll update sales and put in backlog item with the intake link. Thanks team :thumbsup:
